name: Inwood
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Inwood, NY
blurb: The north end of Manhattan, at Dyckman Street, with the Palisades directly across and Spuyten Duyvil Creek just upriver.

tide.label: NOAA 8518902 Dyckman Street
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8518902 at the Dyckman Street ferry slip, a few hundred yards from the launch.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.

current.label: NOAA HUR0611_16 George Washington Bridge
current.note: Current from NOAA station HUR0611_16 (George Washington Bridge), about a mile and a half downriver, at the 14 ft bin nearest the surface.
